LGS4056HDA.note: The LGS4056H as the bolt earring uses it (boards/bolt-earring/circuit.json U2; simple_earring scripts/circuit.py, 'charger'), which is the datasheet's typical application (Picture 5, p.5) without the NTC divider and without the status LEDs: TEMP grounded (NTC check off, as p.5 and p.8 ask when no NTC is used), CE tied to VCC (always enabled), CHRG and DONE brought out as open-drain signal ports for a host's pulled-up inputs. Parts by role; `reference_ref` is the bolt's designator, `note` the datasheet's label. Values and LCSC numbers are the bolt's. RPROG 18 kohm sets 50 mA, for the bolt's small LPR302823 cell.

U1.note: 4.20 V, DFN2x2-8 (suffix DA, top mark 4056H, p.1). KiCad has no LGS4056H symbol; TP4056-42-ESOP8 has the same pinout: its pins 1 TEMP, 2 PROG, 3 GND, 4 VCC, 5 BAT, 6 ~STDBY (= DONE), 7 ~CHRG, 8 CE, 9 EPAD (= PAD) match Table 3.2 (p.3) pin by pin. The footprint is KiCad's own; the bolt's parts.pretty copy of the same name differs only in its 3D model. Its pads (0.25 x 0.7 mm at 0.5 mm pitch, EP 0.9 x 1.5 mm, pad 9) sit inside the p.13 drawing (leads 0.18-0.32 mm wide, EP 0.9 +/-0.1 x 1.6 +/-0.1 mm), checked pad by pad: pads 1-4 down the left, 5-8 up the right, as Picture 3 (p.3).

CIN.note: CVCC (Component Selection p.6): 10 uF effective value, ceramic, close to VCC (pin 4) and GND (pin 3), p.3 and p.11. The bolt's part is 10 uF 10 V X5R 0603; at the 5 V bias it keeps well under 10 uF (lgs4056h.vin.cin, bolt deviation kept). It is also the bolt's only VBUS bulk capacitor.

CBAT.note: CBAT (Component Selection p.6): 10 uF effective value, ceramic, BAT to GND (Table 3.2 p.3). Same 10 V X5R 0603 part as CIN; at 4.2 V bias it too keeps less than 10 uF (lgs4056h.vbat.cbat, bolt deviation kept).

RPROG.note: RPROG (Picture 5 p.5; Component Selection p.6): 1 % to GND as Table 3.2 asks. Below 300 mA, I_BAT = 900 / R_PROG (mA, kohm; p.3, p.7) = 900 / 18 = 50 mA: the bolt's choice, 0.36C and under its LPR302823 cell's 70 mA maximum charge current (the bolt's design/parts/r8-rprog.md, not vendored here). The datasheet tabulates only 1, 1.2, 2 and 9 kohm (Table 4 p.4) and gives no tolerance on ICC; 18 kohm is the 900-constant formula extrapolated.

VIN.note: Charger input, the USB 5 V (VBUS): VCC (pin 4) and CE (pin 8, tied high: charging always enabled, as Table 3.2 allows). 4.0 V start, 6.5 V overvoltage stop (typical), 24 V withstand, 28 V absolute maximum (p.1, p.3, p.4).

VBAT.note: The cell's positive terminal (the bolt's VBATT). 4.20 V regulation. On the bolt this node carries only the cell (BT1) and its power-path FET: the system runs from VBUS while a cable is in, so the charge current reaches the cell and the 1/10 termination can happen.

GND.note: Chip ground (pin 3), the exposed pad (9) to a large copper area with vias (p.3, p.5, p.11), and TEMP (pin 1) grounded: no NTC, the battery temperature check is off (p.5: 'NTC function is not used, ground the TEMP pin').

CHRG.note: Open drain, low while charging (Charge Status Indicator p.7). The bolt's net CHRG, to RP2350 GPIO19 with its internal pull-up. The datasheet's own use is an LED cathode with 1 kohm or more from VCC (p.5, p.6); an unused status pin is to be grounded, not left open (p.5, p.7).

DONE.note: Open drain, low when charge is complete (Charge Status Indicator p.7). The bolt's net CHRG_DONE, to RP2350 GPIO28 with its internal pull-up. The datasheet forbids a pulse on DONE while VCC powers up (p.5, p.7): lgs4056h.status.done_no_pulse.

ports.note: Pins by number; what each function means, its supply and default net class. WDFN-6 2x2 (CASE 511BR) numbering from the WDFN-6 pin description (p.3) and the pin assignment (p.1, top view). The NCP730BMT330TBG is a fixed 3.3 V 'version B' part: pin 2 is NC (all fixed versions) and pin 5 is PG (versions with power good), per the ordering table (p.29). The package's symbol (kicad/Regulator_Linear_NCP730.kicad_sym) has the same numbers and names, with the exposed pad as pin 7 to match KiCad's WSON-6 footprint (the bolt's own footprint calls it EP).

IN.note: Power supply input. Recommended 2.7-38 V (p.4), absolute maximum -0.3 to 40 V (p.4). Needs at least 1 uF (effective) of X5R/X7R ceramic as close as possible (p.14). Internal UVLO turns the output on above 1.6-2.6 V (1.95 V typ) rising, 0.05-0.3 V hysteresis (p.5). For the output to stay in regulation VIN must stay above VOUT-NOM + VDO (p.14)

OUT.note: Regulated output, 3.3 V nominal (NCP730BMT330TBG, p.29). Range is the worst-case sum of output accuracy -1 %/+2 % (TJ -40 to 125 C; +/-1 % to 85 C), line regulation 0.2 % and load regulation 0.4 % (downward with load), p.4. 150 mA rated, current limit 200-450 mA (p.5). Dropout 290 mV typ, 480 mV max at 150 mA (p.5); below VIN = 3.3 V + VDO the output follows VIN - VDO, which this range does not include. Needs 1-100 uF effective, 1 mohm-200 mohm ESR on OUT (p.14). GND.note: Ground pin 3, and the exposed pad, which 'should be connected to the GND plane' (p.3) and is the package's main heat path (RthJCb 11 C/W, p.4; Power Dissipation p.25)

EN.note: Enable, active high. Internal pull-up current source to an internal rail VCCEN (2.5-4.5 V, VIN dependent), 0.01-1 uA (0.3 uA typ): left unconnected the regulator is on (p.3, p.17). Rising threshold 0.7-1.05 V, hysteresis 0.01-0.2 V, so a level below 0.5 V is off in the worst case (p.5). Absolute maximum -0.3 V to VIN + 0.3 V (p.4): EN is not an independent high-voltage pin. A pull-down that holds it off must sink the pull-up current: 1 uA max into R gives 1 uA x R (p.5, p.18)

PG.note: Power good, open drain (version B only): high (released) for power OK, low for fail. Goes low when VOUT falls below 90-96 % of nominal (93 % typ) after a 75-270 us deglitch; released 120-600 us after VOUT rises above threshold + hysteresis (p.5). Low level 0.4 V max at 1 mA; 3 mA absolute maximum; pin limit -0.3 V to VIN + 0.3 V (p.4, p.5). Needs an external pull-up. If not used, 'could be left unconnected or shorted to GND' (p.3)

levels.note: supply is IN. Open drain: VOL 0.4 V max at IPG = 1 mA; its high is the pull-up's rail, which must stay within VIN + 0.3 V

NC.note: Not internally connected on all fixed versions (pin 2). 'This pin can be tied to the ground plane to improve thermal dissipation' (p.3); otherwise left open

source.locator: p.1 (pin assignments, WDFN6 top view); p.3 (pin description, WDFN-6); p.29 (ordering information: NCP730BMT330TBG, marking MF, 3.3 V, with PG)

en.note: Active high: on above 1.05 V, off below 0.5 V (worst case). Internal pull-up (up to 1 uA) turns the regulator on if EN floats, so 'off' needs a driven low or a pull-down of at most a few hundred kohm. Never above VIN + 0.3 V: a driver from a rail higher than IN (USB 5 V when IN is a battery) needs a clamp or divider

pg.note: Power good: released when VOUT is in regulation, pulled low (0.4 V max at 1 mA) below 93 % typ of nominal. Needs a pull-up to a rail no higher than VIN + 0.3 V

NCP730BMT330TBG.note: The NCP730 as the bolt earring uses it (boards/bolt-earring/circuit.json U3; simple_earring scripts/circuit.py, '3.3V LDO'): the datasheet's fixed-output application with PG (Figure 3, p.2) with the bolt's own 1 uF input and output capacitors, EN brought out as a port (the bolt drives it from its power latch, net PWR_EN) and PG brought out as an optional open-drain port (the bolt leaves it unconnected: list it in no_connect). Parts by role; `reference_ref` is the bolt's designator, `note` the datasheet's label. Values and LCSC numbers are the bolt's. Pin 2 is NC on fixed versions and is left open, as on the bolt.

U1.note: Fixed 3.3 V, version B (with PG), WDFN6 2x2 CASE 511BR, marking MF (p.29). KiCad has no NCP730 symbol, so the package carries one (kicad/Regulator_Linear_NCP730.kicad_sym): pins 1 OUT, 2 NC, 3 GND, 4 EN, 5 PG, 6 IN, 7 EP (GND) match the WDFN-6 pin description (p.3) and the top-view pin assignment (p.1) pin by pin; the bolt's netlist agrees (1 3V3, 3 GND, 4 PWR_EN, 6 VSYS, EP GND, 2 and 5 open). Footprint: KiCad's WSON-6-1EP_2x2mm_P0.65mm_EP1x1.6mm (pads 0.375 x 0.40 mm at +/-0.8875 mm, 0.65 mm pitch, EP 1.0 x 1.6 mm, pad 7) against onsemi's recommended mounting footprint (p.32: pads 0.45 x 0.40 mm, 2.30 mm overall, EP 1.12 x 1.72 mm): same pitch and pad width, pads 0.075 mm shorter, EP 0.12 mm smaller each way; the package's EP is 0.90-1.10 x 1.50-1.70 mm (D2, E2). The bolt used its own simple_earring footprint WDFN-6-2x2 (pads 0.45 x 0.30 mm at +/-0.975 mm, EP pad named EP).

CIN.note: Figure 3 'CIN 1 uF' (p.2). Samsung 1 uF 25 V X5R 0402, the bolt's 'NCP730 IN decap'. IN needs 1 uF or more, X5R or X7R, as close as possible (p.14); the electrical characteristics are given at 1.0 uF effective (p.4 note 4). At the bolt's 3.0-4.95 V VSYS this 0402 has less than 1 uF left (DC bias, the derating p.14 warns of for 0402), but the bolt's VSYS also carries C29, 10 uF 0603, the power path's bulk capacitor, which stays with the board (ncp730.cin.min).

COUT.note: Figure 3 'COUT 1 uF' (p.2). Same part as CIN. OUT is stable with 1-100 uF effective capacitance and 1 mohm-200 mohm ESR, placed as close as possible to OUT and GND (p.14). At 3.3 V DC bias this 0402 has less than its 1 uF nominal, so on its own it sits below the stated range (ncp730.cout.range, contested); on the bolt the 3V3 rail also carries the RP2350's 4.7 uF VREG input capacitor C11 and eleven 100 nF decouplers of the RP2350, flash, IMU and U8, which belong to those packages, not this one.

VIN.note: Input. On the bolt this is VSYS: the cell through Q2 (about 3.0-4.2 V) or USB VBUS through the silicon diode D3 (about 3.7-4.95 V). Recommended 2.7-38 V, absolute maximum 40 V (p.4). In regulation only while VIN > 3.3 V + VDO (p.14): VDO is 480 mV max at 150 mA (p.5), and about 70-100 mV at 20 mA (typical curves, Figure 15-16 p.7), so the 3V3 rail follows a nearly flat cell down rather than staying at 3.3 V.

VOUT.note: 3.3 V output, 150 mA rated (current limit 200-450 mA, p.5); the bolt's 3V3 rail (RP2350, flash, IMU, light sensor, level shifters). Nothing else may drive this rail: VOUT's absolute maximum is the lower of VIN + 0.3 V and 6.0 V (p.4).

GND.note: GND pin 3 and the exposed pad (pin 7), which 'should be connected to the GND plane' (p.3) and carries the heat (p.25).

EN.note: Enable, active high: on above 1.05 V, off below 0.5 V worst case (p.5). An internal pull-up of up to 1 uA turns the LDO on if EN floats (p.3, p.5), so a board that wants it off must pull it down (the bolt: R17 100 kohm, at most 0.1 V). Never above VIN + 0.3 V (p.4). On the bolt EN is PWR_EN, driven by the power latch (SW_ON through BAV99W D2, diode 1) and by VBUS through the R18/R17 100k/100k divider, with D2's diode 2 clamping it to VBATT + Vf; that network is the board's, not this package's.

PG.note: Power good, open drain, optional: the bolt leaves it unconnected, which the datasheet allows ('could be left unconnected or shorted to GND', p.3); list it in no_connect. A host that reads it adds a pull-up to a rail no higher than VIN + 0.3 V (p.4), e.g. 3V3; RPG 3.3 k-500 k is the datasheet's worked range (p.24).

ports.note: Pins by number; what each function means, its supply and default net class. SOT-666 numbering from the TECH PUBLIC pin diagram (p.1), which matches ST's Figure 1 (p.1) pin for pin: 1 and 6 I/O1, 2 GND, 3 and 4 I/O2, 5 VBUS. The KiCad symbol Power_Protection:USBLC6-2P6 has the same numbers and names (checked pin by pin). Each I/O is one line that passes over its pin pair (flow-through), so both pins of a pair go on the same net. A passive clamp: no logic levels and no interfaces (no interface type describes a pass-through protector).

IO1.note: Protected line 1 (on the bolt, USB D+). Rail-to-rail steering diodes to VBUS and GND. Cj 0.35 pF typ, 0.5 pF max I/O to I/O at 0 V (TECH PUBLIC p.2); ST gives 2.5 pF typ, 3.5 pF max I/O to GND at 1.65 V (p.2). Clamps at most 10 V at 1 A and 14 V at 5.5 A, 8/20 us (TECH PUBLIC p.2). The line enters on pin 1 and leaves on pin 6

IO2.note: Protected line 2 (on the bolt, USB D-). Same cell as IO1. The line enters on pin 3 and leaves on pin 4

citation.locator: Pin configuration p.1; Electrical Characteristics p.2

VBUS.note: The steering diodes' positive rail and the cathode of the internal TVS (Zener) to GND; connect to USB VBUS. VRWM 5 V max, VBR 6 V min at 1 mA, IR 0.08 uA max at 5 V (TECH PUBLIC p.2). ST's application bypasses it with CBUS = 100 nF (Figure 18 p.9)

citation.locator: Pin configuration p.1; Electrical Characteristics p.2

GND.note: The clamp's return: its track to the ground plane must be as short as possible, since its inductance adds directly to the clamping voltage (ST §2.2-2.3 pp.4-5)

USBLC6-2P6.note: The USBLC6-2P6 as the bolt earring uses it (U5 and C28 there): the protector across USB D+/D- and VBUS, with ST's CBUS = 100 nF on VBUS (ST Figure 18, p.9). The part is TECH PUBLIC's USBLC6-2P6 (LCSC C2827693), a second source of ST's; its own datasheet has no application circuit, so the circuit follows ST's. Each protected line is one port on both pins of its pair: the line comes in from the connector on pin 1 (pin 3) and leaves for the device from pin 6 (pin 4), crossing the package with no stub (ST Figures 7 and 18, pp.5 and 9).

U1.note: The bolt's U5: TECH PUBLIC USBLC6-2P6, SOT-666, a second source of ST's part (ST's own is LCSC C15999). Symbol pins 1 I/O1, 2 GND, 3 I/O2, 4 I/O2, 5 VBUS, 6 I/O1 match the TECH PUBLIC pin diagram (p.1) and ST Figure 1 (p.1) pin by pin. KiCad's SOT-666 footprint pads 1-6 are the same as the bolt's own parts.pretty/SOT-666 (identical apart from UUIDs) and follow the TECH PUBLIC outline (p.4): pin 1 at the dot, 1-3 along one side, 4-6 back along the other.

CBUS.note: The bolt's C28, Samsung 100 nF 16 V X7R 0402. ST Figure 18 (p.9) draws 'CBUS = 100nF' from VBUS to GND right at the VBUS pin; the TECH PUBLIC datasheet shows no application circuit. The bolt's circuit only shows C28 on VBUS/GND; that it is U5's CBUS (and not a decoupler of something else on VBUS) is read from its value and nets, and the bolt's README does not say.

DP.note: Protected line I/O1, the bolt's USB_C_DP: connector D+ into pin 1, out of pin 6 toward the device's series resistor. Both pins are one line passing over the package (flow-through), so both go on the one net; route connector -> pin 1 -> across -> pin 6 -> device, with no stub to the clamp (usblc6.layout.flow_through).

DM.note: Protected line I/O2, the bolt's USB_C_DN: connector D- into pin 3, out of pin 4 toward the device. Same flow-through rule as DP.

VBUS.note: USB VBUS from the connector. The clamp's rail: the steering diodes' high side and the internal TVS cathode. Up to 5 V working (TECH PUBLIC VRWM, p.2).

GND.note: The clamp's return. Pin 2 to the ground plane by the shortest track and a via right at the pad (usblc6.layout.short_tracks, interface.esd.tvs_ground).

ports.note: Pins by number; what each function means, its supply and default net class. LGA-14L numbering from DocID030071 Rev 3 Table 2 (p.20) and Figure 1 (p.18). The KiCad symbol Sensor_Motion:LSM6DS3 has the same 14 numbers and functions (checked pin by pin in KiCad 9 and 10); its names differ only in case (SDX, SCX for SDx, SCx).

I2C_SDA.note: I2C serial data (SDA); SPI SDI / 3-wire SDO when CS is low. Input without pull-up (Table 18 p.48): needs an external pull-up to Vdd_IO (§6.3 p.39). Standard or fast mode, 400 kHz max (Table 7 p.27)

levels.note: supply is VDDIO. VOH and VOL at 4 mA, the pad's maximum drive (Table 4 note 2); control pins take up to Vdd_IO + 0.3 V (Table 9, which prints the lower limit as '0.3', read as -0.3 V)

I2C_SCL.note: I2C serial clock (SCL); SPI SPC when CS is low. Input without pull-up (Table 18 p.48); needs an external pull-up to Vdd_IO

levels.note: supply is VDDIO. VOH and VOL at 4 mA, the pad's maximum drive (Table 4 note 2); control pins take up to Vdd_IO + 0.3 V (Table 9, which prints the lower limit as '0.3', read as -0.3 V)

SA0.note: I2C address LSb (SA0) in I2C mode, SPI SDO otherwise. Input without pull-up by default (pull-up only with SIM = 1, Table 18 p.47): tie to GND (address 0x6A, 1101010b) or to the supply (0x6B, 1101011b), §6.3.1 p.39

levels.note: supply is VDDIO. VOH and VOL at 4 mA, the pad's maximum drive (Table 4 note 2); control pins take up to Vdd_IO + 0.3 V (Table 9, which prints the lower limit as '0.3', read as -0.3 V)

CS.note: 1: SPI idle / I2C enabled; 0: SPI, I2C disabled. Tie to Vdd_IO for I2C (§6.1 p.38). Input with pull-up by default (disabled by I2C_disable = 1, Table 18 p.47), but the datasheet still asks for it tied high

levels.note: supply is VDDIO. VOH and VOL at 4 mA, the pad's maximum drive (Table 4 note 2); control pins take up to Vdd_IO + 0.3 V (Table 9, which prints the lower limit as '0.3', read as -0.3 V)

INT.note: Programmable interrupt outputs, push-pull and active high by default (CTRL3_C PP_OD = 0, H_LACTIVE = 0, §9.15 p.63); open drain or active low by register. Default pin state: output forced to ground (Table 18 p.47). Unlike the LSM6DSO there is no I3C and no power-on strap on INT1. INT2 is also the DEN input (Table 2 p.20)

levels.note: supply is VDDIO. VOH and VOL at 4 mA, the pad's maximum drive (Table 4 note 2); control pins take up to Vdd_IO + 0.3 V (Table 9, which prints the lower limit as '0.3', read as -0.3 V)

AUX_MASTER.note: SDx/SCx: I2C master (MSDA/MSCL) in Mode 2. In Mode 1 (unused): connect to VDDIO or GND (Table 2 p.20). Input without pull-up by default (PULL_UP_EN in 1Ah enables one, Table 18 p.47), so the pin must be tied

levels.note: supply is VDDIO. VOH and VOL at 4 mA, the pad's maximum drive (Table 4 note 2); control pins take up to Vdd_IO + 0.3 V (Table 9, which prints the lower limit as '0.3', read as -0.3 V)

NC.note: Pins 10, 11: 'Leave unconnected', electrically unconnected but soldered to the PCB (Table 2 note 2, p.20). Input with internal 30-50 kohm pull-up by default, which a register sequence can disable (Table 18 pp.47-48). (The LSM6DSM/LSM6DSO have OCS_Aux/SDO_Aux here; this part does not)

VDD.note: Core supply, 1.71-3.6 V (1.8 V typ); absolute max -0.3 to 4.8 V. 100 nF ceramic as near the pin as possible (C1 in Figure 15)

VDDIO.note: I/O supply, 1.62 V to Vdd + 0.1 V (so at most 3.6 + 0.1, and never more than 0.1 V above VDD); sets the logic levels (VIH 0.7*Vdd_IO, VIL 0.3*Vdd_IO) and the pull-up rail. 100 nF ceramic as near the pin as possible (C2 in Figure 15). nominal_v's 3.6 is VDD's maximum, the bound when VDDIO shares VDD's rail

GND.note: 0 V supply, pins 6 and 7; both are soldered

i2c.note: No internal pull-ups on SDA and SCL: the bus needs them, to Vdd_IO. Slave address 110101xb, x = SA0

spi.note: 4-wire SPI (10 MHz max, Table 6 p.26) when CS is low: SPC on SCL, SDI on SDA, SDO on SDO/SA0. Not available in this package's circuit, which ties CS to VDDIO for I2C

citation.locator: §3.1 Table 2 p.20; §6.1 Table 10 p.38; Table 6 p.26

int1.note: Push-pull and active high by default (open drain or active low by CTRL3_C). Forced to ground by default

int2.note: Push-pull and active high by default; forced to ground by default. Also the DEN input. May be left unconnected

aux.note: Sensor hub (Mode 2): an I2C master for external sensors, fast mode only. Unused (Mode 1): SDx and SCx to VDDIO or GND

LSM6DS3TR-C.note: The LSM6DS3TR-C as the bolt earring (simple_earring rev 2, U6) uses it: the datasheet's Mode 1 connection (DocID030071 Rev 3, §7.1 Figure 15, p.45) in I2C mode. CS tied to VDDIO for I2C (§6.1 p.38), SDO/SA0 to GND for address 0x6A (§6.3.1 p.39), SDx/SCx (aux master, unused) to VDDIO, INT1 out, INT2 a port the bolt leaves open, NC pins 10 and 11 unconnected but soldered (Table 2 note 2, p.20), C1/C2 100 nF on VDD and VDDIO, pull-ups on SDA and SCL. VDDIO shares the 3.3 V rail with VDD: Table 4 (p.24) allows Vdd_IO up to Vdd + 0.1 V, which one rail always meets, and the host (RP2350 IOVDD) is at 3.3 V too. Parts by role with the bolt's values and LCSC numbers; `reference_ref` is the figure's label (C1, C2; the figure's two Rpu are not numbered, so R1/R2 are conventional). The bolt's own references: U6, C23 (VDD), C24 (VDDIO), R14 (SDA), R15 (SCL). R_SDA_PU and R_SCL_PU are optional: a board that has its own pull-ups on the bus omits both (instance omit).

U1.note: KiCad has no LSM6DS3TR-C symbol. Sensor_Motion:LSM6DS3 matches DocID030071 Table 2 (p.20) pin by pin, in KiCad 9 and 10: 1 SDO/SA0, 2 SDx, 3 SCx, 4 INT1, 5 VDDIO, 6 GND, 7 GND, 8 VDD, 9 INT2, 10 NC, 11 NC, 12 CS, 13 SCL, 14 SDA; only the case of SDX/SCX differs, and its pins 10 and 11 are no-connect pins, as on this part. (Sensor_Motion:LSM6DSM was not used: its pins 10 and 11 are OCS_Aux/SDO_Aux, which this part does not have.) Footprint checked against Figure 17 (p.111): 14 pads 0.475 x 0.25 mm at 0.5 mm pitch, 0.1 mm in from the 2.5 x 3.0 mm package edge, so pad centres at x +/-1.1625 and y +/-0.9125, as the KiCad pads are; numbering and the pin-1 corner match Figure 1 (p.18). KiCad's land is 0.625 x 0.35 mm against TN1383's 0.575 x 0.35 (pad + 0.1 mm), see lsm6ds3trc.land.pattern. The bolt itself uses EasyEDA's LGA-14_L3.0-W2.5-P0.50-TL (0.675 x 0.28 mm lands at x +/-1.26, y +/-1.01, same numbering).

C_VDD.note: Figure 15 'C1 100 nF' on VDD (pin 8): 100 nF ceramic as near as possible to the supply pin (§7.1 p.45; Table 2 note 1 p.20). The bolt's C23 ('IMU VDD decap'), Samsung X7R 16 V 0402.

C_VDDIO.note: Figure 15 'C2 100 nF' on VDDIO (pin 5), as near as possible to it (§7.1 p.45). The bolt's C24 ('IMU VDDIO decap'). VDDIO shares the 3.3 V rail with VDD but keeps its own capacitor at its own pin, as the figure shows.

R_SDA_PU.note: Figure 15 'Rpu' (10 kohm) from SDA to Vdd_IO; both lines must have external pull-ups (§6.3 p.39). The bolt's R14, 4.7 kohm (YAGEO 1 % 0402) instead of ST's 10 kohm, so that 400 kHz fast mode meets its 300 ns rise time with up to 300e-9/(0.8473*4700) = 75 pF of bus capacitance (SLVA689A eq. 6, Table 2-1 p.3); 10 kohm allows only 35 pF. Above the minimum (3.3-0.4)/3 mA = 967 ohm (eq. 1). Optional: omit both pull-ups if the board's bus already has them.

R_SCL_PU.note: Figure 15 'Rpu' from SCL to Vdd_IO; the bolt's R15. Same value and reasoning as R_SDA_PU. Optional with it.

GND.note: Both GND pins (6, 7). SDO/SA0 (pin 1) to GND sets the I2C address LSb to 0: 7-bit address 1101010b = 0x6A (§6.3.1 p.39), leaving 0x6B free for a second LSM6DSx on the same bus; the pin has no pull-up by default (Table 18 p.47), so it must be tied. Route each to the plane with its own trace, not a plane flood onto the pad (lsm6ds3trc.layout.ground_by_trace).

VDD.note: 3.3 V rail for VDD (pin 8, 1.71-3.6 V) and VDDIO (pin 5, 1.62 V to Vdd + 0.1 V), Table 4 p.24. CS (pin 12) is tied to Vdd_IO to select I2C (§6.1 p.38). SDx/SCx (pins 2, 3), the unused I2C-master pins, go to VDDIO as the bolt has them; Mode 1 allows VDDIO or GND (Table 2 p.20), and with no pull-up enabled by default (Table 18 p.47) either draws nothing. The pull-ups go to Vdd_IO (§6.3 p.39), the same rail.

SDA.note: I2C data to the host (the bolt's IMU_SDA); open-drain bus, 400 kHz max (Table 7 p.27).

SCL.note: I2C clock from the host (the bolt's IMU_SCL).

INT1.note: Interrupt 1 to a host GPIO (the bolt's IMU_INT1, wake on motion); push-pull, active high by default (CTRL3_C p.63), forced to ground by default (Table 18 p.47), so it needs no pull-up or pull-down.

INT2.note: Interrupt 2 (or DEN input) to a host GPIO; push-pull, forced to ground by default (Table 18 p.47). The bolt leaves it unconnected, which a driven output allows.

ports.note: Pins by ball; what each function means, its supply and default net class. YZV (DSBGA-4) ball map from SLVSB49F Table 1 and Pin Functions (p.3): A1 VOUT, A2 VIN, B1 GND, B2 ON. The KiCad symbol Power_Management:AP22913CN4 (Diodes' pin-compatible AP22913) has the same four ball numbers with names OUT, IN, GND, ON (checked ball by ball), and its footprint Package_CSP:WLCSP-4_0.89x0.89mm_Layout2x2_P0.5mm puts A1 top-left, A2 top-right, B1 bottom-left, B2 bottom-right at 0.5 mm pitch: the datasheet's laser-marking (top) view turned 180 degrees, not mirrored.

VIN.note: Switch input (the P-MOSFET's source). 1.4-5.5 V recommended, 6 V absolute maximum. Bypass with a ceramic capacitor to GND, 1 uF minimum in the recommended operating conditions, placed close to the pins. UVLO keeps the switch off below 1.2 V (max, rising). Quiescent current 2 uA typ, 7 uA max at 4.2 V while on; off-state supply current 0.2 uA typ, 7 uA max at 4.2 V

VOUT.note: Switch output. Not a regulated rail: it follows VIN less ILOAD x rON (60 mOhm typ, 80 mOhm max at 25 C, 110 mOhm max over temperature, VIN 4.2-5.25 V), so it has no fixed nominal_v; a board gives the rail its voltage. With ON low the TPS22913B/C pull it to GND through the 150 ohm quick-output-discharge resistor (153 ohm typ, 200 ohm max). 2 A continuous, 2.5 A pulsed (< 300 us, 2 % duty). Full-time reverse-current protection opens the switch when VOUT exceeds VIN by VRCP (44 mV typ), within 10 us

GND.note: Ground, ball B1; also the return of the quick-output-discharge resistor

ON.note: Switch control, active high on the TPS22913B/C (high: VOUT = VIN; low: VOUT pulled to GND). Do not leave floating. Low-threshold input meant for 1.2-5.5 V GPIO: VIH 1.1 V, VIL 0.4 V (0.6 V when VIN is 3.61-5.5 V). Input leakage 1 uA max

levels.note: supply is VIN. VIH 1.1 V min over the whole VIN range 1.4-5.5 V; VIL 0.4 V max for VIN 1.4-3.6 V and 0.6 V for VIN 3.61-5.5 V (the expression; with VIN unknown it evaluates to the worse 0.4 V); VON recommended 0-5.5 V, absolute maximum 6 V. VIH does not scale with VIN, so a 1.8 V or 3.3 V GPIO drives ON at any VIN; ION, the input leakage, 1 uA max at VON 1.4-5.25 V or GND

TPS22913BYZVR.package: DSBGA-4 (YZV), 0.90 x 0.90 mm nominal (p.1; 0.858-0.918 mm on the drawing), 0.5 mm pitch, 0.5 mm max height

source.locator: §7 Table 1 and Pin Functions p.3; YZV mechanical drawing 4206083/C (PDF p.36)

on.note: Active high, VIH 1.1 V, VIL 0.4 V: a 1.8 V or 3.3 V GPIO drives it directly. Must not float: the package's R_ON (10 kOhm to GND) holds it low, so the switch is off until the host drives the pin high

TPS22913BYZVR.note: The TPS22913B as the bolt earring uses it (U4, U9, U10: one switch per LED zone, VSYS in, VLED_L/R/C out, ON from an RP2350 GPIO). The datasheet's typical application (Figure 50, p.20) is the switch with CIN, CL and a GPIO on ON; the bolt adds a 10 kOhm pull-down on ON and puts a 10 uF CL beside each switch, and has no per-switch CIN (VSYS's own capacitors serve all three switches; see tps22913.vin.cin). Parts by role; reference_ref is the bolt's left-zone instance (U4, R10, C20; U9/R33/C78 for the right zone, U10/R34/C79 for the centre). The 100 nF capacitors on each VLED rail belong to the LED chain (led_chain recipe), not to this package.

U1.note: TPS22913B: 66 us typical rise at 3.3 V, quick output discharge, active-high ON (Device Comparison Table p.3). KiCad has no TPS22913 symbol; Power_Management:AP22913CN4 (Diodes' pin-compatible part) has balls A1 OUT, A2 IN, B1 GND, B2 ON, the same as SLVSB49F Table 1 / Pin Functions (p.3: A1 VOUT, A2 VIN, B1 GND, B2 ON), checked ball by ball. Its footprint Package_CSP:WLCSP-4_0.89x0.89mm_Layout2x2_P0.5mm has pads A1/A2/B1/B2 at (-0.25,-0.25)/(0.25,-0.25)/(-0.25,0.25)/(0.25,0.25) mm, 0.235 mm round: the same positions as the bolt's own YZV0004ADAD footprint (0.23 mm pads) and TI's 0.5 mm-pitch, 0.20-0.25 mm ball drawing (4206083/C, PDF p.36).

COUT.note: Figure 50 'CL'. Optional in the datasheet (§11.1.4 p.20; its design example uses 0.1-1 uF, §11.2.1 p.21); the bolt puts 10 uF 10 V X5R 0603 beside each switch as the zone rail's bulk (bolt C20/C78/C79, added with the switch in simple_earring's circuit.py). It sets the inrush (tps22913.inrush.current: about 0.5 A peak at nominal capacitance with the zone's 100 nF bypasses) and is larger than the shared VSYS capacitance feeding it, against the CIN > CL recommendation (tps22913.cap.ratio, contested).

R_ON.note: Not in Figure 50. ON must not float (§7 p.3, §11.1.2 p.20): this pull-down holds it low, so the zone is off (VOUT discharged to GND, Table 2 p.19) while the RP2350 is unpowered or booting, before firmware drives the GPIO (tps22913.on.boot_off). With ON leakage at its 1 uA maximum (p.5) it sits at 10 mV, far under VIL 0.4 V; a 3.3 V GPIO driving it high spends 0.33 mA.

VIN.note: Switch input, 1.4-5.5 V (p.4). On the bolt: VSYS (cell 3.0-4.2 V through the path FET, or VBUS less a diode, up to about 4.95 V). The datasheet asks a ceramic bypass of 1 uF or more close to VIN (§8.3 p.4, §11.1.3 p.20); this package has none and the board's VIN net must provide it (tps22913.vin.cin).

VOUT.note: Switched output to one LED zone (bolt VLED_L, VLED_R, VLED_C). Follows VIN less ILOAD x rON (110 mOhm max over temperature, p.5); pulled to GND through about 150 ohm when ON is low (TPS22913B/C quick output discharge).

GND.note: Ground, ball B1. The layout example (§13.2 p.30) ties the VOUT capacitor's ground and the GND ball together directly.

ON.note: Enable from a host GPIO, active high (bolt LED_EN_L/R/C on RP2350 GPIO). VIH 1.1 V, VIL 0.4 V (p.4): 1.8 V or 3.3 V logic. Pulled to GND inside the package, so leaving it undriven means off.
